messages:
maya: Quick proposal — make client-facing error text intentionally terse but always include a stable hint_code and a console runbook URL. That keeps UX small for apps but gives us a single key to look up human-friendly guidance in the Console.

kyle: +1 on stable hint_code. My only worry: mobile apps may auto-fetch the runbook URL and blow network. Can we make guide_url optional (only returned for admin clients)? :thinking: 

liam: We also need a consistent status mapping doc. Proposal: 400 -> client input errors (invalid payload, length), 429 -> quota/exhaustion, 503 -> capacity/fallback. Wire error codes start with RI (e.g. RI-400-INPUT_TOO_LARGE). Keep HTTP semantics.

ana: quick nit: we should avoid leaking topology in hints. e.g. don’t return region names or exact model variants in hints. If routing suggestion is useful, return an opaque routing_token that SDKs can exchange with the service for an automated retry.

ryan: Telemetry idea: attach hint_code to the trace/span as attribute `err.hint_code`. For any request with a hint_code, increase trace sampling to 100% for 30s so we can capture a replay window. Example rule: `if err.hint_code is present -> trace.sample.rate = 1.0 for 30s`. That helps debugging without full-rate tracing.

deploy-bot: CI: created branch `feature/error-hints` and opened PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/214 :rocket:

maya: Example minimal error response (wire contract) we should standardize: 
```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "input_too_large",
  "message": "input exceeds max tokens",
  "hint_code": "RI.INPUT_SIZE_EXCEEDED",
  "retry_after": null,
  "guide_url": "https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/errors#RI.INPUT_SIZE_EXCEEDED"
}
```
Note: message is short and safe for clients; `hint_code` is the canonical key we resolve in Console.

kyle: For quota/429 we should include `retry_after` (seconds) when applicable. For soft-fallbacks (we returned degraded model) send 200 with `degraded: true` and `hint_code` explaining quality downgrade — still keep it explicit.

liam: Migration plan thoughts: do a 3-month opt-in period where SDKs map old freeform messages -> hint_code heuristically, and server emits both fields. After 3 months we flip default to hint_code-first. We must preserve existing status codes, don’t change HTTP semantics.

ana: Can we add a tiny machine-only field `telemetry_tags` (list of short tokens) that’s never displayed to end users but helps backend routing/aggregation? E.g. `["quota_high","prefix_cache_miss"]`.

ryan: Implementation snippet for sampling rule (pseudo):
```yaml
telemetry_rules:
  - match: "err.hint_code != null"
    action:
      set_trace_sample_rate: 1.0
      sample_window_seconds: 30
```
This will spike traces when new hints appear and let SRE correlate.

maya: Console UX: show table keyed by hint_code with columns: observed_count, severity (info/warn/error), common_root_cause, runbook_link, suggested_client_action. Admins can click hint_code to see example requests and recent traces.

kyle: SDK changes: add helpers to map hint_code -> local copy of short guidance to avoid hitting guide_url on mobile. Sync via small periodic metadata call. That avoids per-error network fetch.

liam: Security note: never return internal debug tokens or full stack traces. If we need to surface a trace id, provide a `support_trace_token` that maps to an internal-only lookup.

ana: question: can we include a numeric `retry_after` for backoff guidance on transient 503s? e.g. `{ "retry_after": 30 }` — consistent with 429 conventions.

maya: Agree — include `retry_after` where meaningful.

ryan: Follow-ups I’ll take: 1) telemetry sampling PR, 2) add hint_code to traces, 3) dashboard panel prototype.

maya: Follow-ups from Product: 1) finalize minimal wire contract (we have draft above), 2) Console mapping table spec, 3) SDK metadata sync spec. Plan: sync next Tue. :calendar: 

kyle: Sounds good. I’ll draft the SDK shim and an RFC for migration window.

deploy-bot: PR updated with schema tests: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/214#event-12345

maya: Awesome, thanks everyone. If there are no blockers I’ll move draft to RFC on Monday. :thumbsup:
